Name: Valleystar Martini Recipe
Author: AbrahMods
Description:
Valleystar Martini (CP)
This mod adds a brand-new drink to Stardew Valley: the [i]Valleystar Martini[/i]. This golden cocktail shines with starfruit and passionfruit sweetness and a bubbly, refreshing vibe. It appears as a craftable cooking recipe and a drink item with its own sprite and description.
What’s Inside:
[list]
[*]A new cooking recipe: [i]Valleystar Martini[/i]
[*]Recipe: 1× Starfruit, 1× Sugar, 1× Wine
[*]Provides +150 Energy and +60 Health
[*]Sells for 700g
[/list]Requirements:
[list]
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/utility/smapi]SMAPI[/url] – the modding API for Stardew Valley
[*][url=https://www.curseforge.com/stardewvalley/mods/content-patcher]Content Patcher[/url] – framework to load this content pack
[/list]Installation:
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.

[*]Install Content Patcher.

[*]Download and unzip this mod.

[*]Place the folder Valleystar Martini (CP) inside your [code]Mods[/code] folder, located in your Stardew Valley installation directory.
[list]
[*]On Windows: usually [code]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods[/code]
[*]On Mac: [code]~\Library\Application Support\StardewValley\Mods[/code]
[*]On Linux: [code]~/.local/share/StardewValley/Mods[/code]
[/list]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI.

[/list]The [i]Valleystar Martini[/i] will now be available in your cooking menu, with its own sprite and description.
Design by Abrah.
